liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World-->* (13:41)** (2 reviews): Reviewer had long sought the ending of this horn-laced Eyes, heard on a cut-off radio tape, and found it here; Reviewer singles out Eyes of the World as a highlight of the recording [13][17]
- **//China Cat Sunflower%--> (8:25)** (1 review): The China>Rider patch lands at the peak, entering a jam section heard only in 1973-74; possibly the best version [21]
- **Nobody's Fault But Mine--> (4:46)** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Nobody's Fault as great [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Tico Tico/tuning (4:03)**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 4 archived performances [22]
- **Merry-Go-Round Brokedown--> (0:35)**: rare: 7 archived performances [22]
- Earliest performances in the archive: equipment break (0:59) [22]

## The recordings

- **gd73-09-24.sbd-aud.cotsman.11620.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 27 songs; 172 min; rated 3.57/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the recording clear, with every band member audible in a tight performance; Reviewer calls the sound quality so bad they stopped listening; suggests it for hardcore fans only; Reviewer calls it a very poor-sounding recording of a good show [10][12][13][14]
- **gd1973-09-24.sbd.tobin.95740.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 175 min; rated 4.71/5 by 7 [2]
- **gd1973-09-24.mtx.tobin.95744.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 175 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [3]
- **gd1973-09-24.aud.GEMS.95729.flac16**: audience recording; 25 songs; 175 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [5]. Said about its sound: GEMS audience recording sounds good, but the jam between China Cat and Rider is patched from a muffled alternate source [17]
- **gd1973-09-24.sbd.stephens.5839.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 81 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [9]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says Jerry's guitar sounds lovely on the soundboard [16]

## Around the show

- Martin Fierro and Joe Ellis play horns on the late second-set run, as at much of late 1973 [10]
- Wake of the Flood had been out only a few months, so hearing its songs live stood out [11]
- Martin Fierro and Joe Ellis play horns on Eyes of the World [2]
- Martin Fierro and Joe Ellis play horns on Eyes of the World [3]
- Martin Fierro and Joe Ellis play horns on Eyes of the World [5]
- Reviewer ranks it third among East Coast early-70s shows, behind Roosevelt Stadium 1972 and Capitol Theatre 1971 [11]
- Lacks Dark Star, The Other One or Playin', so not a top 1973 show, though playing is solid [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-09-24.sbd-aud.cotsman.11620.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard and Audience Composite [1]
- **gd1973-09-24.sbd.tobin.95740.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin and Jamie Waddell; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [2]. Also: Soundboard chain runs master reel to 7.5 ips reels (JG, then WB) to CD; still only partial; This soundboard adds eight songs not previously circulating, including China Cat, Rider, Around and Around, Ramble On Rose, full Weather Report Suite, Sugar Magnolia [2]
- **gd1973-09-24.mtx.tobin.95744.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [3]. Also: Matrix mixes four sources, roughly half soundboard and half audience, varying with the combination [3]
- **gd1973-09-24.aud.GEMS.95729.flac16**: transferred by Jamie Waddell and Kevin Tobin; source: Master Audience Reel >Reel > CD [5]. Also: Uploader says this show is not in the Dead's vault; another reel generation may exist [5]
- **gd1973-09-24.sbd.stephens.5839.shnf**: transferred by Dan Stephens; source: SBD -> ? -> DAT [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Gary Manasse Grateful Dead: [1973-09-24 Civic Arena, Pittsburgh, PA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1973-09-24-civic-arena-pittsburgh-pa-usa/) [24]
